name: Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 332/12)
description: The Ontario Building Code made under the Building Code Act, 1992. The 2024 Building Code came into force on 1 January 2025 and has been mandatory for permit applications since 1 April 2025, revising over 1,700 provisions — the largest change to the Code to date, and a deliberate harmonisation move toward the National Construction Codes. For Lancaster the load-bearing divisions are Part 6 (heating, ventilating and air-conditioning) and Part 7 (plumbing), plus Part 3 and Part 9 requirements engaged by construction work. The practical audit exposure is documents, specifications and estimating templates still written against the pre-2025 Code.
authority: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing
scope: Construction, renovation and change of use of buildings in Ontario, including mechanical and plumbing work
changes_summary: Over 1,700 provisions revised, harmonising Ontario requirements with the National Construction Codes. In force 1 January 2025; mandatory for permit applications from 1 April 2025.

families.name: Permits, Edition Currency and Inspection
families.description: The administrative chain that makes the work lawful.

controls.name: Building Permit Obtained Before Work
controls.description: Permits required for the scope are obtained before work starts, and the permit reference is recorded against the project.

controls.name: Current Code Edition Applied
controls.description: Design, estimating and installation reference the 2024 Building Code, and any document or template still written to the prior compilation is identified and updated.

controls.name: Mandatory Inspection Stages
controls.description: Required inspections are called at the correct stage, deficiencies are corrected and re-inspected, and the inspection record is retained.

controls.name: Qualified Designer and Design Responsibility
controls.description: Where the Code requires a qualified designer or professional engineer, that qualification is held and recorded, and design responsibility is unambiguous.

families.name: Part 6 Mechanical and Part 7 Plumbing
families.description: The technical divisions Lancaster's trades work to daily.

controls.name: Part 6 — HVAC Design and Installation
controls.description: Heating, ventilating and air-conditioning work meets Part 6 requirements for ventilation rates, equipment installation, duct systems and combustion air.

controls.name: Part 7 — Plumbing Systems
controls.description: Plumbing work meets Part 7 requirements for drainage, venting, water distribution, materials and cross-connection control.

controls.name: Fire Separation and Penetration Sealing
controls.description: Penetrations of fire separations by ducts, piping and conduit are sealed with a tested and listed system appropriate to the assembly, and the installation is documented.

controls.name: Material and Product Approval
controls.description: Materials and products are approved for the application under the Code, with certification or authorization evidence retained where required.

families.name: Occupancy and Closeout
families.description: Finishing lawfully — the stage most often left incomplete in the record.

controls.name: Occupancy Requirements Met
controls.description: Conditions for occupancy are satisfied and documented before the space is handed over or used.

controls.name: As-Built Records and Closeout Package
controls.description: As-built drawings, commissioning results, permits and inspection records are compiled into a closeout package, provided to the owner and retained.
